newsitem.title: USA: Illinois grain elevator blast under investigation.
newsitem.headline: Illinois grain elevator blast under investigation.

text.p: Investigators from the Illinois Fire Marshall's office will arrive Monday to determine the cause of the collapse and subsequent explosion and fire that destroyed a grain elevator at Lakeland F-S Inc grain facility late Saturday in Shelbyville, Ill., a local fire official said.
"It did collapse. It did have an explosion," said Glen Fisher, an official with the Shelbyville Fire Protection District.
Local reports said the explosion and fire may have occurred after the grain elevator, containing 50,000 bushels of wheat, collapsed.
"When we got there a 120-foot tall structure was not there, it was on the ground," said Fisher.

Fisher said grain dust may have contributed to the explosion because the wood and tin elevator was filled with wheat from this summer's harvest. There were no injuries or deaths from the blast or fire, and employees had vacated the facility about two hours earlier.
Nearby concrete silos and some metal grain bins also sustained damaged from the blast, said Fisher.
